title: DataConfidentiality
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Confidentiality inherent-and-system data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that ensure it is only accessible and interpretable by authorized users in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent and System-Dependent Data Quality — Confidentiality).

confidentialityClassification.description: Data confidentiality classification. PUBLIC = no restriction. INTERNAL = organization-internal. CONFIDENTIAL = restricted to authorized roles. STRICTLY_CONFIDENTIAL = need-to-know basis with enhanced controls.

encryptionRequired.description: Whether data must be encrypted at rest and in transit.

maskingRequired.description: Whether data must be masked or anonymized in non-production environments.
